50795320.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human IDO1 by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.3. Surface pla: The interaction between compound 1 and the IDO1 protein was determined using surface plasmon resonance (SPR). Purified human IDO1 protein was immobilized on sensor chip CM5 (GE Healthcare) and carried out at 25 °C on Biacore T200 instruments. HBS-EP buffer (0.01 M HEPES, 0.15 M NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.05% v/v Surfactant P20, pH 7.4) was used as running buffer. The ratio of the association and dissociation rate constants was determined as the affinity (K_D).
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Fig. 5. SPR analysis of compound 1 with IDO1 protein. Concentration from top to bottom: 20 μM, 12.5 μM, 10 μM, 6.25 μM, 1.5625 μM, 0.78125 μM. The equilibrium dissociation constant (K_D) value is 9.828 μM.
original_paragraph.Results - 2.5. SPR analysis: To further validate the interaction between compound 1 and IDO1 protein, surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay was conducted using a Biacore T200 optical biosensor. As shown in Fig. 5, the response unit (RU) values were proportional to compound concentrations within the selected ranges. The equilibrium dissociation constant (K_D) between compound 1 and IDO1 was 9.828 μM, which demonstrated its binding affinity to the target IDO1 protein.
